smb_customers.description: Kitewing Software customers (fictional B2B field-service SaaS; synthetic data). One row per customer account, current state as of 2026-11-06. Includes churned customers (is_active = false).

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer id, e.g. C-1001. Joins to orders, invoices, tickets and usage.

columns.name: industry
columns.description: Industry: HVAC & plumbing, Facilities management, Fire & security, Elevator maintenance, Pest control & landscaping.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Sales region: North, South, East, West, Central.

columns.name: technicians
columns.description: Field technicians employed by the customer.

columns.name: licensed_technicians
columns.description: Technicians licensed on Kitewing FieldOps today.

columns.name: plan
columns.description: Current plan: Starter, Growth or Enterprise.

columns.name: addons
columns.description: Comma-separated add-ons owned: Route Optimizer, Assist, Insights (empty if none).

columns.name: renewal_date
columns.description: Next renewal date (last contract end for churned customers).

columns.name: arr_usd
columns.description: Annual recurring revenue in USD after discounts (0 for churned customers).

columns.name: health_score
columns.description: Customer health score 0-100 (>= 80 Healthy, 60-79 Watch, < 60 At risk).

columns.name: account_owner
columns.description: Account Executive who owns the account.

columns.name: acquisition_channel
columns.description: How the customer was acquired: Inbound, Webinar, Referral, Outbound, Partner, Trade show.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: False when the customer has churned.

columns.name: churn_date
columns.description: Date the customer churned (NULL when active).

smb_products.description: Kitewing price book (synthetic): plans, add-ons and services with list prices.

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Product id, e.g. PRD-GROWTH. Joins to smb_orders.product_id.

columns.name: list_price_usd
columns.description: List price in USD per billing unit (annual-billing price for plans).

smb_orders.description: Order lines (bookings) for Kitewing customers, 2022-2026 (synthetic). Recurring lines are 12-month terms; amount_usd is the booked contract value of the line after discount.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Order id (several lines can share one order).

columns.name: order_type
columns.description: new (first contract), expansion (more seats or add-ons) or renewal.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Technicians licensed on the line (1 for flat or one-time items).

columns.name: discount_pct
columns.description: Total discount % applied to the line.

columns.name: term_months
columns.description: Term in months (12 for recurring lines, 0 for one-time services).

columns.name: amount_usd
columns.description: Booked value in USD after discount (recurring: quantity x unit price x term x (1 - discount)).

smb_pipeline.description: Sales opportunities created 2025-01-01 to 2026-11-05 (synthetic): new logos, expansions and renewals with stage, amount and outcome.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer id for expansions/renewals; NULL for new logos.

columns.name: stage
columns.description: Prospecting, Discovery, Solution Validation, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed Won, Closed Lost.

columns.name: amount_usd
columns.description: Expected first-year contract value in USD.

columns.name: is_closed
columns.description: True when Closed Won or Closed Lost.

columns.name: lead_source
columns.description: Inbound, Webinar, Referral, Outbound, Partner, Trade show, Customer base.

columns.name: competitor
columns.description: Main competitor: Fieldnest, ServiceGrid Pro, DispatchPro 7 (status quo) or None.

columns.name: loss_reason
columns.description: Reason for Closed Lost (NULL otherwise): Price, No decision, Chose Fieldnest, Chose ServiceGrid Pro, Timing, Missing feature.

smb_support_tickets.description: Customer support tickets 2025-01-01 to 2026-11-06 (synthetic). SLA first-response targets: P1 30 min, P2 120 min, P3 480 min, P4 1440 min.

columns.name: resolved_at
columns.description: When it was resolved (NULL if still open).

columns.name: category
columns.description: Mobile app, Scheduling, Billing, Integrations, Reporting, Training, Single sign-on, Permissions, Feature request, Route Optimizer, Assist.

columns.name: resolution_hours
columns.description: Hours from open to resolution (NULL if unresolved).

columns.name: sla_breached
columns.description: True when first response exceeded the priority's SLA target.

columns.name: csat
columns.description: Customer satisfaction 1-5 after resolution (NULL when not answered).

smb_invoices.description: Customer invoices (synthetic). Net-30 terms; status as of 2026-11-06.

columns.name: status
columns.description: paid, open (not yet due) or overdue.

columns.name: days_to_pay
columns.description: Days from invoice date to payment (NULL if unpaid).

smb_product_usage.description: Monthly product usage per active customer, Nov 2025 - Oct 2026 (synthetic). One row per customer per month.

columns.name: active_technicians
columns.description: Technicians who completed at least one job in the mobile app that month.

columns.name: first_time_fix_rate_pct
columns.description: % of jobs fixed on the first visit.

columns.name: assist_queries
columns.description: Questions asked to Kitewing Assist (0 when not owned).
